summaries.title: How Well Does GPT-4o Understand Vision? Evaluating Multimodal Foundation Models on Standard Computer Vision Tasks
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「模型幻觉、事实失真与长程一致性退化」痛点，作者围绕 **How Well Does GPT-4o Understand** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖模型幻觉（Hallucination）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we benchmark the performance of popular multimodal foundation models (GPT-4o, o4-mini, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen2-VL, Llama...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **COCO, ImageNet**。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we benchmark the performance of popular multimodal foundation models (GPT-4o, o4-mini, Gemini 1.5 Pro and Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude 3.5 Sonnet,...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We observe that 1) the models are not close to the state-of-the-art specialist models at any task）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 36 赞），本工作修正了对 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Lost in Latent Space: An Empirical Study of Latent Diffusion Models for Physics Emulation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Lost in Latent Space** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：In this work, we investigate whether a similar strategy can be effectively applied to the emulation of dynamical systems and at what cost。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this work, we investigate whether a similar strategy can be effectively applied to the emulation of dynamical systems and at what cost。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **1000x**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We find that the accuracy of latent-space emulation is surprisingly robust to a wide range of compression rates...；We also show that diffusion-based emulators are consistently more accurate than non-generative counterparts and...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 22 赞），本工作修正了对 **视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Eka-Eval : A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Large Language Models in Indian Languages
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于系统与工程框架。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Eka-Eval** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、工具调用（Tool Use）。核心论点主张：We present EKA-EVAL, a unified and production-ready evaluation framework that integrates over 35 benchmarks, including 10 Indic-specific datasets, spanning categories like...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Compared to existing Indian language evaluation tools, EKA-EVAL offers broader benchmark coverage, with built-in support for distributed inference, quantization,...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The framework is open-source and publicly available at  eka-eval and a part of ongoing EKA initiative ( which aims to scale up to over 100 benchmarks and establish a robust,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 14 赞，出自 Lingo Research Group），本工作证明了系统级编排/底层执行优化在 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 落地中的决定性收益；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: LitBench: A Benchmark and Dataset for Reliable Evaluation of Creative Writing
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈」痛点，作者围绕 **LitBench** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：In pursuit of robust evaluation for creative writing, we introduce LitBench, the first standardized benchmark and paired dataset for creative writing verification, comprising...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In pursuit of robust evaluation for creative writing, we introduce LitBench, the first standardized benchmark and paired dataset for creative writing verification,...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **73%, 78%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our benchmark identifies Claude-3.7-Sonnet as the strongest off-the-shelf judge, reaching 73% agreement with human preferences; among trained reward models, Bradley-Terry and...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 5 赞），本工作可作为评估 **人类反馈与偏好优化 (RLHF/DPO)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；提供项目主页与可视化案例参考。
